Conversion Prompt for vendor subfolder.

version 0.03 created on 2 january 2025 by Skybuck Flying.

Step 1. Read textfile: "AI System Prompts\JulesConversionPrompt.md"

Step 2. Read textfile: "vendor\ConversionStatusV3_Output.txt"

Step 3. Find all *.go files in vendor\ConversionStatusV3_Output.txt which do not yet have a *.pas file. Look for "does not exist".
        Once found:
        Convert these *.go file using the jules conversion prompt directives to *.pas. Golang to Delphi conversion.
        Save the *.pas next to the *.go file in the same folder. Make sure to follow coding style guide lines.
	
Step 4. Once the file is converted, run vendor\CheckPascalConversionStatus.exe this will automatically generate a new ConversionStatusV3_Output.txt which should update the exist status.

Step 5. Then proceed and pick ten new *.go file to convert which does not yet have a *.pas file.
